ideas.name: Sillguard condensation wick strip
ideas.concept: Self-adhesive absorbent wick and drip channel for the bottom of window frames; replaceable cartridge strips (consumable).
ideas.target_customer: Nordic renters and homeowners with older double-glazed windows
ideas.problem_solved: Winter window condensation pooling on sills and frames
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (credits and search budget exhausted). Hypothesis only, based on known Nordic winter condensation and energy-saving ventilation habits.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Profile geometry and fit-to-frame sizing system (VELUX-style frame knowledge), refill subscription

ideas.name: Rechargeable mineral humidity buffer pods
ideas.concept: Design-led zeolite/clay pods for wardrobes, attic storage and cabins, recharged in the oven or on a radiator; no chemicals, no batteries.
ideas.target_customer: Homeowners with attic, cabin or basement storage
ideas.problem_solved: Damp smell and mildew risk in closed storage spaces
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches could be run. Hypothesis: disposable moisture absorbers are common, reusable design versions less so.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Brand, textile pouch design, validated recharge guide; no medical or mould-kill claims

ideas.name: Tilt-stop micro-ventilation clip
ideas.concept: Stamped steel/aluminium clip that locks a tilt-and-turn window at a fixed 8-10 mm gap for permanent trickle airing while keeping it burglar-resistant and draught-controlled.
ideas.target_customer: Homeowners and renters with tilt-and-turn windows
ideas.problem_solved: Poor ventilation versus heat loss and security worries when windows are left open
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches possible. Founder ex-VELUX domain insight that fixed-gap ventilation is a real unmet pattern, but demand data not checked.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Founder window-hardware expertise, per-brand compatibility chart, possible design registration
ideas.tooling_needed: Sheet-metal stamping die (approx EUR 800-2,000, verify; near tooling limit)

ideas.name: Analog brass hygrometer plus airing guide
ideas.concept: Battery-free design hygrometer calibrated at 40-60% marks with a Nordic-language 'vädra rätt' airing card, packaged as a gift/home item.
ideas.target_customer: Design-aware homeowners in Sweden and Denmark
ideas.problem_solved: No intuitive way to know when to air out or when indoor humidity is high
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches possible. Digital monitors exist, analog design variants unchecked; crowding unknown.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design and content/brand; weak copy resistance, so differentiate via calibration certificate and bundle

ideas.name: Magnetic tilt-window insect and dust mesh
ideas.concept: Frame-fit magnetic mesh panel for tilted windows allowing nightly ventilation without insects or dust, sized to Nordic window standards.
ideas.target_customer: Renters and homeowners with tilt windows
ideas.problem_solved: Can't leave windows tilted for ventilation due to insects and dust
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches possible. Generic mesh products are likely already common on Amazon EU, so flooding risk is high.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Precise Nordic frame size matrix and magnet-frame design; weak
ideas.tooling_needed: None (cut and sewn mesh, magnetic tape)

ideas.name: Window-frame cold-bridge insulation tape kit
ideas.concept: Thermal-break adhesive foam strips for window reveals and frames reducing cold surfaces where condensation forms, sold as a sized kit.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic homeowners renovating or renting old apartments
ideas.problem_solved: Cold window edges causing condensation and mould spotting
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches possible; hypothesis from building-physics knowledge that cold bridges drive condensation.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Technical guide and fit system from building-industry expertise; avoid performance claims without testing
